essence: These items constitute the oblation materials for eradication.
The eradication oblation is performed at night with śleṣmāntaka and vibhītaka.
Subjugation is accomplished by offering grapes, cakes, and guggulu.
These substances further specify the oblations for subjugation.
Good fortune is sought through oblations of these fragrant substances.
